annotations.title: Upload media to an X ad account

description: Upload an image or video (any URL — a Hermoso render, an upload_file URL, a public file) to an X ad account and return its media_key, for create_x_ads_card or create_x_ads_post. Added to the ad account's Media Library and read back. A card image must be 1:1 ≥600×600, 1.91:1 ≥600×314, 16:9 ≥600×337, 9:16 ≥600×1066, 2:3 ≥600×900 or 4:5 ≥600×750. Free.

adAccountId.description: X ad account id (list_x_ads_accounts); omit if only one is shared

url.description: public image or video URL: a Hermoso render, an upload_file URL or any public file
